subject: general
question: Find the area of the sector when the radius of the circle is 16.2 units and the length of the arc is 5 units.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of a **sector** can be calculated directly if the **arc length (l)** and **radius (r)** are known.

Shortcut formula: Area = (1 ÷ 2) × l × r

⇒ Area = 0.5 × 5 × 16.2

⇒ Area = 2.5 × 16.2 = 40.5

**∴ The correct answer is 40.5 units².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Radius (r)** = 16.2 units

**Arc length (l)** = 5 units

**Formula Used:**

Area of **Sector** = (l × r) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fba342da7ad7207c733d6240019357e7cdf4bc97d411285d531dc9b64ed022ba.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (5 × 16.2) ÷ 2

⇒ Area = 81 ÷ 2

⇒ Area = 40.5

**∴ The correct answer is 40.5 units².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arc Length Formula

The length of an arc (l) is given by (θ ÷ 360) × 2πr, where θ is the central angle in degrees.

Sector Area (θ method)

Area of a sector can also be calculated as (θ ÷ 360) × πr².

Perimeter of Sector

The total boundary of a sector is l + 2r, which includes the arc length and two radii.</p
